description: a new engine per case with "policy"; run the steps in order: add (src, dst, ts_ms, count), flush (now_ms), stats; each result equals "expect"

cases.name: graded levels, sustained critical, auto reset, cooldown
confirm mode; reset names the agents of the hottest pairs
late events within late_windows count; older ones are dropped
self messages are not coupling; two agents stay normal (min_agents 3)
a long silence: at most max_empty_windows empty windows, the rest skipped
no empty windows allowed: a gap drops the level to normal
sketch mode: exact limits reached, HyperLogLog counts, bucket estimates, bounded candidates
invalid events are refused and change nothing
mode off: levels and alerts, never a reset
hysteresis: hovering just under a threshold keeps the level
window 250 ms: density is per second
